avoid_supplements.name: Echinacea
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Immunostimulant properties may counteract anakinra's immunosuppressive effects and reduce therapeutic efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; counsel patient on immune-boosting supplement risks with immunosuppressants

avoid_supplements.name: Interferon-alpha supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May potentiate immune activation, increasing risk of serious infections and reducing anakinra efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; provide alternative immune support strategies

caution_supplements.name: Probiotics
caution_supplements.mechanism: May stimulate intestinal immune response; generally safe but monitor for GI tolerance
caution_supplements.action: Use high-quality, well-studied strains; monitor for adverse effects

caution_supplements.name: Vitamin D
caution_supplements.mechanism: Important for immune regulation; deficiency may impair treatment response; supplementation is typically supportive
caution_supplements.action: Maintain adequate levels (25-50 ng/mL); monitor and supplement if deficient

avoid_foods.name: Raw/undercooked animal products
avoid_foods.mechanism: Increased infection risk due to anakinra-induced immunosuppression; pathogens like Listeria, Salmonella pose serious threat
avoid_foods.action: Enforce strict food safety; ensure all meat, poultry, eggs cooked thoroughly; avoid unpasteurized dairy

caution_foods.name: High-sodium foods
caution_foods.mechanism: Patients on anakinra may experience fluid retention; excessive sodium intake may exacerbate hypertension
caution_foods.action: Moderate sodium intake; monitor blood pressure regularly

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit
caution_foods.mechanism: No direct interaction, but may have mild immunostimulant properties; unlikely to significantly affect anakinra
caution_foods.action: No strict contraindication, but moderate consumption advisable

monitoring_notes: Anakinra carries significant infection risk; patients require education on food safety, immunization status review, and signs of infection. Monitor CBC, absolute neutrophil count, liver/renal function regularly, and counsel on avoiding live vaccines and immunostimulating supplements.
